analysis:
This PR adds a coordinated update for a cluster pair. I found no concrete regression.

LifecycleMailbox.swift:35-39 (head) adds cluster-update request/status suffixes. They reuse the existing owner-only directory checks, O_NOFOLLOW/O_EXCL writes, rename-claim and the bounded non-blocking read (lines 52-97). ClusterUpdateDrainRequest.isValid (ClusterUpdateDrain.swift:29-32) checks PID+start-time identity, a UUID, a 0..3600 s timeout and freshness. A same-UID process could already hold a provider out of routing through the operator mailbox (TB-012/T-059, A-018). Drain also ends on timeout or after drainedHoldSeconds=900 (ClusterPairUpdate.swift:22).

The partner Mac's progress arrives over the paired link (ClusterPairUpdateCycle livePartner). It affects only timing (wait, give up, or go on alone). The release version comes from this Mac's own SelfUpdater.checkForUpdate. Download/verify/stage/commit use the existing SelfUpdater under the update lease. A partner cannot pick the binary, so T-013/T-034 are not weakened. Partner-supplied progress.line reaches logs (ClusterPairUpdate.swift:70); this is minor log-content injection only.

ClusterCandidateRecovery.swift moves candidate promotion and rollback (watchdog-equivalent) into the cluster supervisor. Before execv, the start check (lines 90-109) runs the already-committed, verified binary with --version. Rollback restores the verified predecessor. Where the lease is busy, noteLaunch returns notCandidate and observe returns stabilizing; this affects availability only.

Threat-model gap (documentation, not a finding): T-043 describes the watchdog as the rollback authority. It should also cover the cluster supervisor's rollback, execv restart and the pair-coordination link as a new availability input.

For integration, the following lie outside this batch:
- ProviderLoop handling of claimClusterUpdateDrainRequest: that drain only refuses new work, never cancels, and the drainedHold release.
- ClusterSupervisionFiles.read safety used by takeRequest/readProgress.
- SelfUpdater verification, unchanged.
- Authentication of ClusterSetupLinkExchange.
